scenes.title: Order of signed addends
scenes.problem: Calculate both sides and decide whether 7+(-3) = (-3)+7. Explain the rule or the first error.
rows: Swap addends and add the right side: (−3) + 7 = 4.
The results match; addition is commutative even with a negative addend.
scenes.memo: Left = 4; right = 4. The equality is true. The results match; addition is commutative even with a negative addend.
scenes.misconception: Do not swap subtraction or divide; distribute to every bracket term; distinguish an inverse from an identity.
